title: Cheesy Fajita Cauliflower Rice Bowl with Beans, Avocado & Cilantro

steps.text: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into thin strips. Place in a large bowl.

Peel, halve, and slice onions crosswise into ½-inch thick half-moons. Add to the bowl with the peppers along with oil, soy sauce, and spices; toss to combine. Transfer veggies to a large baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer.
Juice one of the limes over the veggies. Cut remaining lime into wedges and set aside for serving.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until veggies are tender and starting to char, about 15 minutes.

Meanwhile, cut cauliflower head into quarters; using a box grater, hold the stem end of the cauliflower and coarsely grate. (Alternatively, transfer cauliflower to the bowl of a food processor; pulse until rice-like in consistency.)
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add cauliflower and salt; cook, stirring often, until cauliflower is lightly golden and cooked through, 5-7 minutes. Remove from heat.
While the cauliflower is cooking, drain and rinse beans.
When the veggies are done, remove from the oven. Add beans and additional soy sauce to the baking sheet; stir to combine, spread out in an even layer, and sprinkle with cheese.
Return baking sheet to the oven and continue to bake until beans are warmed through and cheese is melted, 3-4 minutes more. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and slice crosswise into thin half-moons.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add half to the cauliflower rice and stir to combine. (Set remaining cilantro aside for serving.)
Divide cauliflower rice, cheesy fajita bake, and avocado between bowls; sprinkle with reserved cilantro. Serve with lime wedges for squeezing and enjoy!
